body.name: Deterministic predecessor normal form
body.construction: Process every raw atom \(V_{i,I}=y\) in source order. Delete each intervention pair on a coordinate \(t>i\). If \(i\in\operatorname{dom}(I)\), replace the atom by the truth constant \(\mathbf 1\{I(i)=y\}\); otherwise sort predecessor pairs by coordinate and coalesce repeated identical pairs. Simplify truth constants inside each conjunction, preserve the order of surviving conjunctions, and define \(\boldsymbol\gamma^{\circ}=\mathsf N(\boldsymbol\gamma)\) and its distinct retained context set \(\mathcal H\).
